title: Back to the U.S.A. Border
content: A long line of cars led up to the border crossing as we returned from Canada. It seemed they were stopping and searching everyone.Four guys in flak jackets searched a car in front of us, using mirrors on poles to look under the bumpers. They made the guy get out of the car, escorted him away, and then one of the officers drove off in his car.I asked Doug for his passport. This time I wanted to make sure I presented the passports up front, rather than waiting for the officer to ask me for them.I turned to Dennis. Last time the guard asked us four times if we had firearms, and when he asked Dennis directly, he just shook his head. This time he said he was going to speak up.Tomorrow I'll tell you what happened.
